blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to hand over, to deliver, to give
to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: передава́ть — to hand over, to deliver, to give; признава́ть — to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something); устава́ть — to get tired; скрыва́ть — to hide, to conceal.
**расстава́ться** — to part, to separate. Wiktionary: расста́ться + -ва́ть.
**придава́ть** — to give, to impart; to attach. Wiktionary: прида́ть + -ва́ть.
**сознава́ть** — to realize, to see. Wiktionary: созна́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give, to impart; to attach
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: раскрыва́ть — to open; расстава́ться — to part, to separate; придава́ть — to give, to impart; to attach; сознава́ть — to realize, to see.
